method: Exact taken/outcome inventories are measured by scripts/run-mock-tests.sh --coverage and bound to compiler family, major version and platform; hosted profiles additionally bind the runner image. The gate rejects inventory mismatches and any historical ratio decrease. Updated hosted inventories require authoritative CI confirmation. Historical measurement notes remain in Git; profiles contain the enforced counts. Measurements below identify changed sources and local compiler provenance without changing checker rules or the 95-percent executable-line floor.
